name: Kossel "Benny" Effector for reprap.cc Bowden Hotend

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a custom effector plate designed for a delta 3D printer. It features a central, elevated cylindrical hotend holder with a vertical bore through its core. The main base plate is a thick, flat disc with three distinct, symmetrically arranged mounting wings extending outwards. Each wing contains angled, conical protrusions with horizontal screw holes and embedded hexagonal pockets to hold M3 nuts in place.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric delta 3D printer effector plate designed to hold a RepRap-style hotend. Allow the user to customize the hotend radius using 'hotend_rad' and the height of the hotend holder cylinder using 'hholder_height', while integrating three radial mounting arms with integrated nut traps and screw holes.
captions.factory: The code defines an 'effector' module which uses a difference() boolean operation. The main body is built from a union of a base cylinder, a taller concentric hotend holder cylinder, three rotated cubes acting as structural wings, and horizontal conical mounting tabs built using intersection() of cubes and cylinders. To finish, a central vertical cylinder is subtracted to create the hotend passage, and three custom 'schrauben_cut' modules are subtracted at 120-degree intervals to form the horizontal M3 screw holes and rectangular nut slots.
